build.echo_set_note: Pick by team: Flower of Tinged Yearning for Unison teams, Rejuvenating Glow for Echo teams and general play. Beta calculations found the two close — neither wins everywhere.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: 15% ATK for the whole team, +10% ATK from Fallacy. Main Echo Fallacy grants +10% ER. HP% improves healing.
echo_sets.usage: best for Echo teams and general play

echo_sets.name: Flower of Tinged Yearning
echo_sets.note: 10% ATK for the whole team, 25% ATK with Unison. Formrender adds +10% ER. Farmable now — see the pre-farm guide.

build.fast_path: Fast path (kit verified against the 3.8 release client; exact values confirm at launch): Lullaby + a 5-piece set in a 43311 layout — Flower of Tinged Yearning with Formrender for Unison teams, Rejuvenating Glow with Fallacy of No Return for Echo teams. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, HP% 1-costs, and 260% Energy Regen — her team ATK buff and Echo Skill crit buffs scale with Energy Regen above 190% and max out at 260%. Skill priority: Forte > Liberation > Intro > Basic ATK > Skill. Support rotation: Intro > Skill > BA1-4 > Forte > Liberation > Outro; hold Forte until Finale, use Echo before switching.

ranked_weapons.name: Lullaby
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Passive, Dreamland Solace: Max HP up, her Liberation restores Concerto Energy, and healing with a Heavy Attack gives the whole team Soothed Soul — while it lasts, triggering Unison grants ATK, and the active Resonator gains Echo Skill DMG Bonus. Verified from the 3.8 client; exact values at launch.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: 10-20% ATK to the next Resonator (R1, for team damage). Only 10% ATK applies to the next Resonator.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus; HP% is the alternate. Her finishers convert excess Energy Regen into Crit, so Crit main stats are not the pick.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs — her buffs scale with Energy Regen above 190% and cap at 260%.
HP% on both; HP% improves healing.

profile.role_note: Support and healer. She heals the team, deals AoE damage, gathers enemies while channeling her Forte, and keeps healing through her Resonance Liberation. Her buffs apply in Unison and Echo teams; Lullaby’s buffs do not apply outside them. Kit, sequences and her weapon's passive verified against the 3.8 release client; exact values confirm at launch on Nov 12, 2026.

pull_verdict.verdict: Worth it if you run Unison or Echo teams: Lily is a universal-slot healer/support whose buffs are strongest in Unison and Echo Skill teams. Pull her if those are your teams or you lack a premium sustain. Skip or wait if Shorekeeper or Verina already cover you and you're saving for a future version. Every kit number below is still beta until the Nov 12 launch check — the banner, dates, and lineup are confirmed.
pull_verdict.verdict_label: Worth it — if you run Unison or Echo teams

sources: Wuthering Waves 3.8.0 release client (Global) — sequence names and effects verified Nov 11, 2026; exact values confirm at launch
sequences.verdict: Client-verified mechanics: S2 is the breakpoint — Dream Aroma stacks grant Crit Rate and Crit DMG while Cradle Lullaby is active. Beta testing compared S2R0 to S2R1 Shorekeeper, so no signature weapon is needed for the crit-buff role; that comparison is beta-era and re-checks at launch. S3 is rotation comfort.
sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Dupes before signature for the crit-buff role: chase S2 before Lullaby. The S2R0-versus-S2R1-Shorekeeper comparison is beta-era and re-checks at launch.

teams_meta.note: Beta synergies — Primary: Hsin, Suoming, Sigrika, Lucilla. Secondary: Galbrena, Jinhsi. Almost no synergy: Phrolova (all of Lily's Echo buffs apply only to the active Resonator) and Qiuyuan S3+ (an Echo/Heavy hybrid; in Lily's Echo mode he mainly benefits from the Liberation buff). Galbrena benefits more from Lily than Qiuyuan does. Support packages (Beta): Echo S0R1: 25% AMP, 39% ATK, 10% CR, 20% CD, 24% ES Bonus; Echo S2R1: 25% AMP, 53% ATK, 18% CR, 44% CD, 24% ES Bonus; Unison S0R1: 25% AMP, 90% ATK (S6 Hsin 97%); Unison S2R1: 25% AMP, 90% ATK, 8% CR, 24% CD; General S0R0: 25% AMP, 39% ATK; General S2R0: 25% AMP, 53% ATK, 8% CR, 24% CD; S2R0 SK: 15% AMP, 65% ATK, 12.5% CR, 25% CD. AMP = damage amplification; ES = Echo Skill; SK = Shorekeeper. No full three-member teams are confirmed in the Beta source.
